_comment: One entry per bot. key MUST match the name your bot passes to BotState(bot=...),
because that is what names its files in the state directory.
fills: 'broker' when a broker reports the fill, 'simulated' when the bot books its own.
jev_mode: 'gating' (the model can veto a trade), 'monitor' (score recorded only), 'none'.
Say which it is. A card that hides simulated fills is not reporting, it is advertising.

bots.label: ORB breakout
bots.strategy: Opening range breakout on 8 US stocks, every candidate scored by Jev.
